text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Hey... I found this phone on the floor.
Could you
return it for me, please?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
No calls have come through yet, so
whoever
dropped it must still be close
by...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
And, you know... things like this contain,
well...
memories... and other important
stuff.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
So don't keep them waiting... I'm sure
they'd
rather have you return their lost
item than me.
